arguments.value: You can’t reliably do this by only editing the registry; Windows applies the accent color through a shell/theme refresh path that typically requires a user session refresh, and in Windows 10 there is no supported public API to change the system accent color live for the whole shell without sign-out/restart. The practical next step is to explain that changing the accent color dynamically isn’t supported, and suggest alternatives such as using a scheduled task to sign out/restart Explorer/session, or limiting the effect to app-specific theming where possible.
